name: Trello
verdict_reason: Wekan does kanban fine (verified boot) and per-seat Trello money is real money for teams. For individuals, Trello's free tier already covers you — don't self-host what's free. Worth it for paying teams comfortable with a plainer board.
what_you_lose: Trello's power-ups, butler automations and mobile apps
The free tier — seriously, check if you even pay

what_broke: Boot to healthy measured at 52s on the 2GB reference env
